newsitem.title: UK: End in sight for Scottish Amicable bid war - paper.
newsitem.headline: End in sight for Scottish Amicable bid war - paper.

text.p: A winner in the two billion stg ($3.19 billion) bidding war for mutually-owned insurance group Scottish Amicable is expected to be announced on Tuesday, the Financial Times said on Monday.
There are three bidders, Prudential Corp Plc, Abbey National Plc and Australian Mutual Provident (AMP).
The paper said the announcement would be accompanied by details of special bonuses for Scottish Amicable's 1.1 million policy holders.

The Financial Times said the manner in which the bonuses would be paid would depend on the winning bid, but payout was likely to exceed the levels indicated by Prudential and Abbey National when they made their offers last month.
SBC Warburg, adviser to Scottish Amicable, was quoted as saying the highest headline figure might not offer the best overall terms to policy holders.
This could potentially mean that one of the losers could challenge the outcome, the paper said.
